doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: The Rika band and funeral bands
title: Founding the Rika band with Willie Parker and Boogerman
summary: Martin describes where the band first rehearsed, how he found a trombonist for Willie Parker in the person of Boogerman, and how Willie Parker came to play bass.
